difficulty_evidence.easy: Observed maximum-gap model construction; complete five-equation sign/function-placement bank.
difficulty_evidence.moderate: Authored positive integer coefficient 2..6 applied to the whole capacity gap, with initial stock supplied as irrelevant contextual data; preserves one-equation modeling-only backbone.
difficulty_evidence.hard: Authored proper rational coefficient from eight reduced values; bank tests reciprocal, denominator omission, coefficient on capacity alone and initial-stock confusion. Hard is a bounded coefficient-placement workload claim, not source-rated evidence or an ODE-solving task.

exceptions.reason: Unrated source has no correct designation or worked solution; excluded from usable inventory and preserved.
Source quantity is measured in units but capacity in units/day; excluded from mathematically validated inventory and preserved.
Historical distractor intent unresolved. Exact full-bank ratios retained as evidence-only profiles, excluded from learner generation.

distinctness: Mathematical identity is the capacity and exact rate. Context, symbols, initial stock, bank, identity, seed and option ordering cannot inflate inventory. All existing practice and canonical models are excluded from newly generated models.
normal_sampling: Only direct_model, known_integer_rate and known_fractional_rate. Current source replay is evidence only.
